name: eBay multi-option listings advertise a headline price that buys a cheaper variant
symptom: P40 24GB appears at ~$105 on eBay but the '$104.98' headline is a multi-option listing ('P4 8GB / P40 24GB / K80 / M40') - that price buys the P4 variant. Actual P40 selections inside those listings run ~$273-310 and dedicated P40 listings cluster $273-325.
root_cause: Marketplace listings bundle several SKUs under one item number; the SEO headline is the cheapest option's price, not the part you searched for.
workaround: Open the variant picker and read the price for the exact part, or filter to single-part listings. Budget ~$110-150 only if you accept the multi-listing lottery, ~$280+ for a clean P40.
